User Profile

Your comment: {{ comment }}

Password Hint: {{ admin_password }}

''' return render_template_string(html_template, username=username, comment=comment, admin_password=ADMIN_PASSWORD) html_template = '''

User Profile

Welcome, {{ username }}!

Your comment: {{ comment }}

''' return render_template_string(html_template, username=username, comment=comment) ```
